preprocessing: All four baselines share the Ollama nomic-embed-text embedding backbone. Because nomic-embed-text's 2048-token context can be exceeded by dense content (JSON blobs, code, hex IDs) at as few as ~4000 chars despite the ~8000-char prose ceiling, we apply a shared character-level truncation with retry-on-500 halving in ZB/a-mem/letta (cap 7800, halving to 975 if Ollama returns 500) and a flat cap of 3900 on both ingest and query in mem0 (whose embedder is inside the mem0ai library and cannot retry). The caveat is reported in the LongMemEval section of the paper.
